name: Tavi
hail: From the edge of the light, to the Yellow in the Dark. We have watched you.
Yellow in the Dark, we speak from the ring where the light ends.
Our sun does not move. From beneath it, we greet the Yellow in the Dark.
close: From the edge of the light. Tavi.
We stay in the light. We watch the Dark. Tavi.
finding: Measured in the light, checked in the Dark: {part}
{part} Exact, as far as light allows.
Counted between flares, and counted again: {part}
This is what the light told us: {part}
{part} No more than the light shows. No less.
sighting: Our eyes are made for dim light. They saw this: {part}
{part} We marked where it stood from the sunward point.
archive: From the record of the light: {part}
Carried in the buried lines, now carried to you: {part}
What we have kept, measured out: {part}
{part} Use it in your light, as we used it in ours.
culture: We live where the light ends. {part}
{part} That is what it is to live at the edge.
Of those who live in the twilight ring: {part}
request: We would have this from you: {part}
Of the Yellow in the Dark, we ask: {part}
verdict: Weighed in light and in dark: {part}
{part} This is where the line falls.
{part} The light does not move, and neither do we.
Where the light ends, we answer: {part}
accord: {part} Fixed, as our sun is fixed.
On the line between our light and yours: {part}
As exact as we can make it: {part}
Between the twilight ring and the Yellow in the Dark: {part}
